resources.string: Original directory opened. When Linux Runtime is available and authorized, it maps to /workspace without a working copy.
Directory opened in place through the document API. No POSIX path; this is not a Git mount.
The source advertises write access. Each operation still checks provider capabilities and live permission; user files were not modified.
CLI requires an explicit working copy for this source; selecting it does not copy or synchronize files.
Source stays in place. Executable/symlink dependencies and output may use private runtime storage. Linux provides HELIX_BUILD_DIR; choose output explicitly without changing the project automatically.
Local storage permission is not granted; private folders and SAF remain available.
